mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_COST_ALLOCATION ( ALLOCATION_ID, ALLOCATION_NO, ALLOCATION_PERIOD, SOURCE_CENTER_ID, ALLOCATION_METHOD, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ALLOCATION_STATUS, ALLOCATION_DATE, IS_GENERATE_VOUCHER, VOUCHER_ID, REMARK, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR ) VALUES ( #{allocationId}, #{allocationNo}, #{allocationPeriod}, CAST(#{sourceCenterId} AS NUMBER), #{allocationMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{allocationStatus}, #{allocationDate}, #{isGenerateVoucher}, #{voucherId}, #{remark}, CAST(#{bookId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{tenantId} AS NUMBER), #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{creator} )
mapper.select: SELECT ALLOCATION_ID, ALLOCATION_NO, ALLOCATION_PERIOD, SOURCE_CENTER_ID, ALLOCATION_METHOD, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ALLOCATION_STATUS, ALLOCATION_DATE, IS_GENERATE_VOUCHER, VOUCHER_ID, REMARK, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocationId} AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT ALLOCATION_ID, ALLOCATION_NO, ALLOCATION_PERIOD, SOURCE_CENTER_ID, ALLOCATION_METHOD, TOTAL_AMOUNT, ALLOCATION_STATUS, ALLOCATION_DATE, IS_GENERATE_VOUCHER, VOUCHER_ID, REMARK, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATOR, UPDATER FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE ALLOCATION_NO = #{allocationNo} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE T_COST_ALLOCATION SET ALLOCATION_METHOD = #{allocationMethod}, TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount}, ALLOCATION_STATUS = #{allocationStatus}, ALLOCATION_DATE = #{allocationDate}, IS_GENERATE_VOUCHER = #{isGenerateVoucher}, VOUCHER_ID = #{voucherId}, REMARK = #{remark}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updater} WHERE ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocationId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND VERSION = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL ( DETAIL_ID, ALLOCATION_ID, TARGET_CENTER_ID, ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE, ALLOCATION_RATIO, ALLOCATED_AMOUNT, REMARK, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR ) VALUES ( #{detailId}, #{allocationId}, CAST(#{targetCenterId} AS NUMBER), #{allocationBasisValue}, #{allocationRatio}, #{allocatedAmount}, #{remark}, CAST(#{bookId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{tenantId} AS NUMBER), #{version}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{creator} )

INSERT INTO T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL ( DETAIL_ID, ALLOCATION_ID, TARGET_CENTER_ID, ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE, ALLOCATION_RATIO, ALLOCATED_AMOUNT, REMARK, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, VERSION, IS_DELETED, CREATE_TIME, CREATOR ) VALUES
( #{item.detailId}, #{item.allocationId}, CAST(#{item.targetCenterId} AS NUMBER), #{item.allocationBasisValue}, #{item.allocationRatio}, #{item.allocatedAmount}, #{item.remark}, CAST(#{item.bookId} AS NUMBER), CAST(#{item.tenantId} AS NUMBER), #{item.version}, #{item.isDeleted}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.creator} )
mapper.select: SELECT d.DETAIL_ID, d.ALLOCATION_ID, d.TARGET_CENTER_ID, d.ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE, d.ALLOCATION_RATIO, d.ALLOCATED_AMOUNT, d.REMARK, d.BOOK_ID, d.TENANT_ID, d.VERSION, d.IS_DELETED, d.CREATE_TIME, d.UPDATE_TIME, d.CREATOR, d.UPDATER, tc.CENTER_NAME as TARGET_CENTER_NAME FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL d LEFT JOIN T_COST_CENTER tc ON d.TARGET_CENTER_ID = tc.CENTER_ID AND tc.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocationId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY d.CREATE_TIME

SELECT d.DETAIL_ID, d.ALLOCATION_ID, d.TARGET_CENTER_ID, d.ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE, d.ALLOCATION_RATIO, d.ALLOCATED_AMOUNT, d.REMARK, d.BOOK_ID, d.TENANT_ID, d.VERSION, d.IS_DELETED, d.CREATE_TIME, d.UPDATE_TIME, d.CREATOR, d.UPDATER, tc.CENTER_NAME as TARGET_CENTER_NAME FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL d LEFT JOIN T_COST_CENTER tc ON d.TARGET_CENTER_ID = tc.CENTER_ID AND tc.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.DETAIL_ID = #{detailId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT d.DETAIL_ID as detailId, d.ALLOCATION_ID as allocationId, d.TARGET_CENTER_ID as targetCenterId, tc.CENTER_NAME as targetCenterName, d.ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE as allocationBasisValue, d.ALLOCATION_RATIO as allocationRatio, d.ALLOCATED_AMOUNT as allocatedAmount, d.REMARK as remark, d.CREATE_TIME as createTime, d.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, -- 计算百分比显示 ROUND(d.ALLOCATION_RATIO * 100, 2) || '%' as allocationRatioPercent FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL d LEFT JOIN T_COST_CENTER tc ON d.TARGET_CENTER_ID = tc.CENTER_ID AND tc.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE d.ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocationId} AND d.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY d.CREATE_TIME OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL WHERE ALLOCATION_ID = #{allocationId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL SET TARGET_CENTER_ID = CAST(#{targetCenterId} AS NUMBER), ALLOCATION_BASIS_VALUE = #{allocationBasisValue}, ALLOCATION_RATIO = #{allocationRatio}, ALLOCATED_AMOUNT = #{allocatedAmount}, REMARK = #{remark}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE, UPDATER = #{updater} WHERE DETAIL_ID = #{detailId} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND VERSION = #{version}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) as totalCount, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN ALLOCATION_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ALLOCATION_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ALLOCATION_STATUS = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as allocatedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ALLOCATION_STATUS = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as auditedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT SOURCE_CENTER_ID) as sourceCenterCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_GENERATE_VOUCHER = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as voucherGeneratedCount FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)
AND TENANT_ID = CAST(#{param.tenantId} AS NUMBER)
AND ALLOCATION_PERIOD = #{param.allocationPeriod}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE ALLOCATION_PERIOD = #{period} AND IS_DELETED = 0
AND BOOK_ID = CAST(#{bookId} AS NUMBER)
AND TENANT_ID = CAST(#{tenantId} AS NUMBER)

SELECT ALLOCATION_METHOD as allocationMethod, COUNT(1) as count, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)
AND TENANT_ID = CAST(#{param.tenantId} AS NUMBER)
GROUP BY ALLOCATION_METHOD ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ALLOCATION_STATUS as allocationStatus, COUNT(1) as count, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as totalAmount FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND BOOK_ID = CAST(#{param.bookId} AS NUMBER)
AND TENANT_ID = CAST(#{param.tenantId} AS NUMBER)
GROUP BY ALLOCATION_STATUS ORDER BY allocationStatus
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION WHERE ALLOCATION_NO = #{allocationNo} AND BOOK_ID = CAST(#{bookId} AS NUMBER) AND TENANT_ID = CAST(#{tenantId} AS NUMBER) AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT DISTINCT CENTER_ID FROM T_COST_CENTER WHERE CENTER_ID IN
CAST(#{centerId} AS NUMBER)
AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_COST_ALLOCATION_DETAIL WHERE IS_DELETED = 1 AND UPDATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{beforeDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
